vetSays.line: 🛡️ Arlo, Seamus, Howard and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down. Arlo, Seamus, Howard, Nino are hurt.
🛡️ Arlo, Seamus, Howard and Ahmed met them at the door — 4 put down. Arlo, Seamus, Howard, Ahmed are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Howard just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Seamus, Howard, Nino, Zoltan and Chloe met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Seamus, Howard, Nino, Zoltan, Chloe are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ahmed just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Seamus just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Seamus, Howard, Nino, Zoltan and Chloe met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Seamus, Howard, Nino, Zoltan, Chloe are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Kyle, Chantal and Alcides met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Alcides didn't come back. Kyle, Chantal are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."

★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ines taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Chloe showed Kyle the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Nino was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Sofia taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Sofia is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
